summary.headline: Zodiac Signs and Seasonal Qualities
summary.text: Chapter Nineteen explains the seasonal, northern and southern, direct- and oblique-ascension, cardinal, fixed, and bicorporeal classifications of the twelve zodiac signs, with Aries through Pisces assigned to seasons and celestial hemispheres. It introduces the conditions of the zodiac signs, planetary conditions, triplicity lords, and hour lords, with a marginal discussion of the equator, latitude, and the Sun in Capricorn.
